changes.summary: Payment period extended from 30 days to 60 days after invoice receipt.
changes.sent_excerpt: Customer shall pay each invoice within thirty (30) days of receipt of the invoice.
changes.signed_excerpt: Customer will pay each invoice within 60 days of receipt of the invoice.

changes.summary: Liability cap doubled from 1x to 2x the fees paid in the preceding 12 months.
changes.sent_excerpt: shall not exceed 1x the fees paid by Customer in the twelve (12) months preceding the claim.
changes.signed_excerpt: will not exceed 2x the fees paid by Customer in the 12 months preceding the claim.

changes.summary: A new Data Processing clause was added requiring the Provider to process personal data only on Customer instructions and sign a data processing addendum.
changes.signed_excerpt: Provider will process personal data only on documented instructions from Customer and will sign the data processing addendum attached as Exhibit B.
